title: Third-party ad serving: assetsurl carried alongside a full assets[] fallback

source.name: IAB Native 1.2 §6.3 — Third-Party Ad Serving Example
source.notes: All source records are retained in assets/sources.json by reference.sourceIds.

modifications: All auction, bid, creative, site and publisher identifiers are synthetic.
All domains use reserved .test names; no real user IDs, IP addresses, consent strings or tracker endpoints.

All text and SVG artwork are original; no public creative copied — the source example's link.url and creative copy are not reproduced (only the field composition: assetsurl present alongside a full assets[] fallback).
Corrected the source example's malformed link.url (a stray space after the scheme, "http: //...") to a well-formed https URL.

Corrected the source example's plcmttype:11 to plcmttype:3, as required by the actual §7.3 enumeration (max defined value 4); the example contains a stale/invalid value — same class of correction as bn-native-25-social-wrapped's §6.1 fix.
device.ip is the documentation-only address 192.0.2.11; OS values describe a synthetic test device.
provenance.sanitized: Only synthetic identifiers, original fixture creatives, reserved domains and TEST-NET addresses. No live tokens, subscriber IDs or real tracking URLs.

pairApplicability.note: Every response bid references an offered impression/item; auction identifiers match.

specNotes: Protocol validity is based on cited fields, not on current Core output. Optional-field warnings do not make this pair invalid.

IAB Native 1.2 §5.1: assetsurl 'overrides the asset object in the response' but assets is 'Recommended as fallback even if assetsurl is provided' — this pair supplies both, exactly as the spec's own §6.3 example does.

nativeAssetCrosscheck/nativeAssetFitness (crosscheck.js) only read the assets[] array and link.url; an unrecognized sibling key such as assetsurl inside the adm JSON blob is not schema-field-checked (adm is an opaque string), so its presence must not produce any finding.
Optional asset 73 (main image) is included even though not required — the source example recommends returning the fallback image alongside assetsurl.
Browser assertions are proposed observables; this corpus has not been run in a browser for this case.
Do not infer rendering from analysis.status or iframe existence alone.

HTTPS Native image URLs use reserved .test domains and are not registered in tests/corpus/assets/manifest.json (assetRefs is empty) — the browser's img-src CSP blocks any remote fetch regardless of interceptor/manifest registration, so no stored fixture is required for this pair's blocked/partial assertions; do not permit live DNS/HTTP traffic.

Current production preview CSP blocks remote Native images. Record card-text rendering and image blocking separately; intercepting a request does not bypass CSP. Do not claim fully rendered images if naturalWidth remains zero.
Inspect intended click target without following it.
notes: Core observations in the source archive were deliberately excluded from expectations. Protocol metadata may describe a vendor-specific 2.x carrier; it does not claim a normative minor-version inference.
